name: extract-markers
description:
Items of marker lists found in a phrase, as whole words, in any case, ё as е; all lists in one pass.

with_prepositions: only the markers right after a toponym preposition («в», «во», «на», «по», «из», «до», «г», «и»; as written, «в,» is none) count, and the preposition goes with them; a marker without one stays. A preposition takes the longest item right after it. remove cuts the pair, extract gives it («в Москве»), find marks the phrases where such a pair stands.
sep: what joins the markers extract gives.

A word glued to punctuation is not matched («москве,»). find, remove and extract take the same markers: left to right, for each word the longest item that starts there (in words, then in characters; a tie keeps the list order: the lists in the given order, your own lists last), and the words of a taken item start no other («Нижний Новгород», not «Нижний Новгород, Новгород»). extract gives them as the list spells them («Москве»; «как сделать», not «как»), in word order. remove keeps the case of the other words.

Example: semkit read --text "отели в москве" extract-markers --lists geo --with-prepositions write -
-> в Москве

lists: the marker lists, comma-separated: a bundled one by its name (geo) or as @markers/geo, or a list of your own as @FILE (one phrase per line, or the first column of a table) or @NAME of a word list.

extract-markers keeps only what the matcher finds in the working column; an empty cell where it finds nothing.
